name_en: Tango barazushi — a layered mackerel sushi from the Tango peninsula
summary_ja: 焼いてほぐしたサバのおぼろを木箱「まつぶた」に敷いたすし飯に散らし、錦糸卵や紅しょうがを彩りよくのせる丹後半島の押し寿司。地元では「ばらずし」と呼ばれ、祭りや祝いの席の定番になっているという。
summary_en: Grilled, flaked mackerel is scattered over sushi rice packed in a shallow wooden box called a matsubuta, then topped colorfully with shredded egg and pickled ginger — a pressed sushi from the Tango peninsula. Known locally simply as barazushi, it is said to be a fixture of festivals and celebrations.
source_title: ばらずし 京都府 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
